resources.string: Scan the code with a phone on the same Wi-Fi. Reorder, rename, change icons, hide apps, make folders, pin inputs and pick a wallpaper. The link stops working when you close this screen.
Connect the TV to Wi-Fi or Ethernet first.
Clock, Hijri date, next prayer, weather
